layout.title: How a fridge works

shows.does: a drink bottle sits in an open box beside a block of ice
the ice block melts into a puddle round the drink while the display climbs
a coil appears on the back wall and frosts over as its liquid boils
the frost on the coil melts away and drips once its liquid has all boiled to gas
a compressor appears below, shakes as it runs, and pumps the gas round the pipes
a ring traced round the compressor
the pipe out of the compressor glows red hot with the squeezed gas
coils appear at the back and shed the heat out into the kitchen
the cooled liquid reaches the coil still squeezed; the coil stays bare and drips
a thin coiled pipe appears, the pressure drops and the coil frosts again as the display falls
the frost keeps spreading and the drink frosts over solid
the thermostat stops the compressor, the pipes go still and the drink thaws
a hand reaches in and takes out the cold drink while the fridge hums
the fridge with its frosty coil and the cold drink in front

layout.why: A fridge stands cut open in a kitchen; a drink bottle on the shelf is the hook and comes back at the end, and the refrigerant is followed round its loop: the cold coil, the compressor, the hot coils on the back, the thin pipe. The camera opens close on the drink and the ice, then frames each part as it is added, and ends on the hand taking the cold drink.

sentences.text: If you chill a drink with ice in a box, you have a fridge.
But the ice melts, and the drink warms up.
So you add a coil where cold liquid boils at minus 26 degrees.
But soon the coil holds only gas and stops cooling.
So a compressor pumps the gas round and squeezes it.
But the squeezed gas comes out burning hot.
So coils on the back shed that heat.
But now that cooled liquid stays squeezed and cannot boil.
So a thin pipe drops the pressure, and it frosts.
But the frost never stops, and the drink freezes.
So a thermostat stops the compressor when it's cold.
Reach in, and grab an ice-cold drink.

ideas.idea: a drink and ice in a box is a fridge
the ice melts and the drink warms
a coil of refrigerant that boils at minus 26 degrees soaks up heat
once it has all boiled to gas the coil stops cooling
a compressor pumps the gas round and squeezes it
condenser coils on the back shed the heat and the gas turns liquid
the liquid is still under pressure and cannot boil in the coil
a thin pipe drops the pressure so it boils and frosts the coil again
it never stops cooling and the drink freezes
a thermostat stops the compressor when it is cold enough
reach in for an ice-cold drink
